text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Three years of challenges with Air Groove are coming to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has reigned supreme as the Empress and left a worthy legacy. She is a beacon that all Umamusume seek to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Air Groove refuses to simply sit back and wait for new challengers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wishes to continue her reign as a challenger herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the days go by, many choose to follow in her dauntless footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The runners are moving from the fourth corner into the final stretch! Will Mejiro Dober manage to take the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober is coming in fast! Oh, and they're neck and neck!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober's coming in from the inside! Look at her go! And she's done it! Mejiro Dober's crossed the finish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Female Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Mejiro Dober! What an incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you. But I'm not satisfied with just this win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have a goal… An ideal I wish to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Female Interviewer
text_block_list.text: An ideal, you say! By which, of course, you mean…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I intend… to challenge Air Groove…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …At the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text: Is this for real?! The old guard and the new taking each other on?!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh my goodness! I don't know who I should cheer for!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's right, Dober… Rise up and face me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course. Nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The day has finally come when Dober is prepared to challenge me, just as she said she would

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Air Groove and I take the long way back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we walk, we discuss the path we've trekked thus far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Air Groove and I don't talk about the past very much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reason is simple, really. She's someone who always has her sights set on what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's not just Dober. Many Umamusume are training hard for the day on which they can take me on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I must continue my reign as Empress so that I can continue to usher them forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And you… You are an indispensable part of that plan, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'm with you all the way.
I'm with you all the way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh… That's what I wanted to hear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then, let me ask you again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How do you perceive me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The answer is clear. I see Air Groove the same way everyone else does.
choice_data_list: In my eyes, you are the ideal Empress.
In my eyes, you are the ideal Empress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's not all…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then I shall pour every last drop of my energy into remaining your ideal Empress.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: After all…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're my ideal trainer.
